summary: On a 2.5 to 2.6 upgrade the private hub Automation Content Administrator role is removed and must be reassigned, same-named teams merge into gateway teams, and hub SSO logins stop working (API tokens stay valid) until SSO is reconfigured in the platform.
questions: Why can't I log in to automation hub with SSO after upgrading to 2.6?
Do automation hub API tokens still work after upgrade?
What happens to the Automation Content Administrator role in 2.6?
How do I restore hub SSO access after upgrade?

answer_card.title: Automation hub changes in 2.5 → 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Automation Content Administrator** role is removed; reassign its permissions manually.
- Hub users are added to same-named gateway teams (teams created if missing); review permissions.
- **Hub SSO UI logins stop working**; API tokens keep working.
- Fix: reconfigure SSO in AAP (for example Generic OIDC or Red Hat SSO/Keycloak).
